name: Flatten Table
changes: The Pro notice for flat table export now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Hold Shift and click column headers to sort by several columns at once.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Flatten Table is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your tables.
